name: SpatialLogic-Bench
description: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made significant progress in static perception, but their ability to understand dynamic task-oriented reasoning remains unclear. Existing benchmarks mainly focus on static spatial relationships and lack systematic assessment of dynamic reasoning capabilities. To this end, we propose SpatialLogic-Bench, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs’ understanding of spatiotemporal logic and their ability to assess task progress.
